name: Papuan Spirit Callers
summary: Highland sorcerers who command the spirits of the deepest jungles on earth. Their magic is raw, primal, and ancient.
lore: The Papuan Spirit Callers live in valleys so isolated that each developed its own magic. Their rituals involve masks that become the spirits they represent — and the spirits are very, very old. The jungle keeps their secrets.

events.title: The Dreamtime Walk
events.narrative: An elder invites you to walk the Dreamtime — the reality beneath reality. The journey takes three days but no time at all.

choiceA.label: Walk the Dreamtime and return changed

choiceB.label: Refuse and stay in the waking world

events.title: The Ocean Spirits
events.narrative: The sea around your territory begins to glow with bioluminescent patterns that form words in a language no human speaks.

events.title: The Volcano Spirit
events.narrative: The dormant volcano on your island begins to smoke. The elders say the fire-spirit within is waking.

events.title: The Wayfinder's Test
events.narrative: A master wayfinder challenges you to navigate to a distant island using only the stars and the spirits.

random.winMessage: You find the island and the wayfinder acknowledges you. +10 Followers.
random.lossMessage: You are lost at sea for days. Four followers lose hope. -4 Followers.

events.title: The Taniwha
events.narrative: A water-spirit from the deep river that feeds your territory surfaces and demands a sacrifice. It is old and hungry.

choiceA.label: Offer it a portion of your power

random.winMessage: You drive the taniwha back into the deep! +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The taniwha drags six followers into the river. -6 Followers.

events.title: The Broken Songline
events.narrative: An ancient songline that crosses your territory has been disrupted. The land itself is sick because of it.

choiceB.label: Redirect the songline around your territory

events.title: The Deep One Rises
events.narrative: Something vast surfaces in the lagoon at midnight. It is not a whale. It is not a squid. It is something that should not be named.

choiceB.label: Ward the lagoon and drive it back

events.title: The Star Path
events.narrative: The wayfinders report that the star paths have shifted. A new route has opened to a place no chart records.

choiceB.label: Record the path and sell the knowledge

events.title: The Mask Spirit
events.narrative: A carved mask in your possession begins to speak at night, claiming to be the spirit of a chief dead for a thousand years.

choiceA.label: Wear the mask and channel the chief

choiceB.label: Bury the mask with proper rites

events.title: The Final Eclipse
events.narrative: The sun darkens for the last time. When it returns, the world will be different — or it will not return at all.

choiceB.label: Guard the light and preserve it
